impl LaneDrainForTheStrip {
    fn drain_controls_for_lane(&mut self, control: &mut Consumer<Record>) {
        while [
            self.first_lane_consumer_count,
            self.second_lane_consumer_count,
            self.third_lane_consumer_count,
        ]
        .iter()
        .sum::<usize>()
            > self.limit
        {
            let Ok(record) = control.try_pop() else {
                break;
            };
            self.apply(record);
        }
    }
}
